# Repository Copilot Instructions
<!-- UNLAZY_SAFE_STANDARD:START -->
## Unlazy safe completion discipline
For substantial work, read and apply `UNLAZY_SAFE_STANDARD.md`. Define observable acceptance gates before implementation, re-verify current evidence before completion, and never infer authority or approval from a passing check. Existing repository governance and Human Gates take precedence.
<!-- UNLAZY_SAFE_STANDARD:END -->
